newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy issues $200 mln in 144a debt.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy issues $200 mln in 144a debt.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Ocean Energy Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager Merrill Lynch & Co Inc, according to a source close to the deal.
Baton Rouge, Louisiana-based Ocean Energy, has said it will use proceeds of the offer to tender for its outstanding 13-1/2 percent senior notes and part of its outstanding credit facility.
The company is engaged in oil and gas exploration and production.
